assetRole: Runtime original character sequences and scene images; unavailable visuals are omitted
rightsOrLicense: Original Trigger Knight assets. Copyright remains with Mintsphere and other applicable rights holders; this repository does not grant a separate public license.
transformations: Original PNG bytes are unchanged. Numbered files remain grouped by entity. Canvas uses a fixed shadow origin per entity, preserves the exported frame canvas, and mirrors enemies to face the hero.

animationReview.source: Visual inspection of all staged entity PNGs and the local original gameplay recording
animationReview.limitations: Pose ranges are derived visual mappings. Cadence and death fades are presentation choices, not recovered Flash timing. Incorrect-entity and shadow-only frames are excluded by the mapping.
